notes.title: UPDATE 1.10.1.0 – MAJOR STABILITY IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/39/4/1506590290-tour-de-france-pcm2016-02.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, 

We're pleased to announce a new update for Pro Cycling Manager 2016! 

Don't forget to update your Steam client for access to the multiplayer mode. 


[h1][b]Changelog 1.10.1.0[/b][/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an offline mode.
[*]Added security checks and information on custom databases.
[/list]


[b]Crash Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash when creating a profile name with invalid characters (including Russian, Asian characters).
[*]Fixed a crash when accessing the loading menu displaying a corrupted save file.
[*]Fixed a crash when switching camera in Podium, Podium is now safely accessible.
[*]Fixed a crash when using Alt-Tab while in a race.
[*]Fixed a crash when leaving the game.
[*]Fixed a crash when advancing a year.
[*]Fixed a crash on AMD GPUs.
[*]Fixed a crash on La Vuelta.
[*]Other random crashes have been fixed.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a blocking bug on ITT/TTT when crossing the finish line without energy.
[*]Fixed multiple issues with dropdown menus.
[/list]

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Update 1.8.0.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/22/1464944345-pcm2016-02.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, 

We're pleased to announce a new update for Pro Cycling Manager 2016! 

Don't forget to update your Steam client to access to the multiplayer mode. 

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version!

[h1][b]Changelog 1.8.0.0[/b][/h1]

[b]Feature[/b]
[list][*]Added: option to deactivate race-day condition and feeling good in multiplayer mode.[/list]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list][*]Fixed: stop tournament countdowns when the player is disconnected, kicked, ... to prevent P2P crash.
[*]Fixed: temporary kick players who join a tournament while it is launching.
[*]Fixed: make sure the connection to NAT traversal is closed when deleting the tournament.
[*]Fixed: player rank displayed even if he has 0 points.
[*]Fixed: crash when pressing the calendar button on tournament during synchronization.
[*]Fixed: display errors when trying to join a tournament.
[*]Fixed: temporary kick popup not appearing.[/list]

[b]Various fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed: crash on startup since 1.7.0.0 caused by changed of backup save filename ( users.cdb~ -> users.bkp ).
[*]Fixed: time trial show profile and checkpoints full rankings.
[*]Fixed: order panel refresh for Time trials.
[*]Fixed: replay page button position on low res.[/list]

[b]Hotfix Update 08/11/16[/b]
[list][*]Fixed: crash at the game launch when the username contains special characters.[/list]

Don't forget to update your Steam client to access to the multiplayer mode.

[h1][b]Changelog 1.4.0.0[/b][/h1]

[list][*]Fix: random crashes of the game.[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.2.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The forth update for [b]Pro Cycling Manager 2016[/b] is now available.

Don't forget to update your Steam client to access to the multiplayer mode.

Here is today's patch log:

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*]Functionality: it is now possible to select the stages of a tour and play with variant stages in a tournament.
[*]Data: the list of tournament races is sorted by category and by date, and it is possible to choose HC continental races.
[*]Fixed: in some cases, stages were not correctly sent to clients of a tournament.
[/list]
[h1]Career and Pro Cyclist[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed: initialisation of young riders (crash on community databases).
[*]Fix: error on the Magazine page in one-off races of a custom tour.
[*]Fixed: several corrections to the interface on Career pages.
[*]Fixed: default sort of the squad page.
[*]Balancing : Reduction of the freshness malus when the rider is close to a season target.
[/list]
[h1]Race[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed: riders were sometimes displayed in error in race highlights.
[*]Fixed: update of the rider information panel in time-trials, depending on the camera.
[*]Fixed: Animation problem on the camera options of the race HUD.
[/list]
[h1]Various[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added: it is possible to associate an image with a Workshop pack.
[*]Fixed: sort of countries and rider types in alphabetical order.
[*]Fixed: erroneous stage number in the results panel.
[*]Fixed: overflow of text describing Workshop packs.
[*]Fixed: text cut on the registration page.
[*]Fixed: some graphic elements crashed because of their specific format.
[*]Update : Jerseys for Orica, FDJ, Cannondale.
[/list]

We've found a problem with custom tournament using big database. The ability to choose a database has been disabled time to fix the problem quickly.

[b]Cyanide Studio & Focus Home Interactive[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/26/1467299098-tdf-paris-gif-1.gif[/img]

Hey everyone, 

We're pleased to announce [b]a third update for Pro Cycling Manager 2016![/b]

Don't forget to update your Steam client to access to the multiplayer mode.

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version!

Please also notice that we plan another update soon with the following features:
[list][*]Multiplayer players will be able to choose their stages (all stages available) [i][in the coming days][/i]
[*]Stage Editor [i][soon][/i][/list]

Here is today's patch log:

[h1][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h1]

[list][*]Fixed: When a host leaves a track game, the remaining players are no longer stuck in the race.
[*]Fixed: Correction of mini-map for clients of a multiplayer game.
[*]Fixed: In Ladder mode, it is no longer possible to vote before all players have arrived.[/list]

[h1][b]Career and Pro Cyclist[/b][/h1]

[list][*]Added : Allow players to change the fitness schedules of team-mates in career mode and to adopt the schedule of team leaders.
[*]Fixed: The point system in the Pro Cyclist calendar.
[*]Fixed: Pro Cyclist salary was not displayed above a certain amount.
[*]Fixed: Race performances displayed twice (Giro-Vuelta).
[*]Fixed: Adjustment to the maximum salary of a Pro Cyclist.[/list]

[h1][b]Race[/b][/h1]

[list][*]Update: The current selection is more visible.
[*]Fixed : A few crashes could appear during the race.
[*]Fixed: A panel was hidden when selecting a certain rider (often A. Valverde).
[*]Fixed: It is no longer possible to give orders to other team members in a Pro Cyclist team time-trial.
[*]Fixed: Order displayed for AI riders in Pro Cyclist.
[*]Fixed: The context-sensitive help sometimes remained on the podium and race highlights.
[*]Fixed: Wrong next order displayed.
[*]Fixed: Icons on profile too big in certain resolutions.
[*]Fixed: The 5 and 8 keys did not change the rider's effort.
[*]Fixed: Overall display of the pictograms on the rider control panel.
[*]Fixed: The "Take position here" order did not work at the first request.
[*]Fixed: Crash when launching a stage for a second time in succession.
[*]Fixed: The result page no longer displays riders who have abandoned during the current stage.
[*]Fixed: Contextual help in the Cooperation panel.
[*]Fixed: Both 0 keys allow all riders to be selected.
[*]Fixed: The Out of time timer is still displayed after the 1 hour mark.
[*]Fixed: The time-trial camera, protection and the mini map in world championships.
[*]Added: When you click on the name of a rider in the standings during a 3D race, the camera moves onto him.
[*]Added: It is possible to change rider protections more easily.
[*]Added: Possibility to request protection as a Next order for a rider in another group.[/list]

[h1][b]Misc[/b][/h1]

[list][*]Workshop: The available Workshop packs are no longer displayed as "selected" by default.
[*]Workshop: The files of a Workshop pack can now be looked at in the publication and choice interface.
[*]Workshop: The publication of a Workshop pack adds a customisable preview image to the pack.
[*]Workshop: The publication of a Workshop pack is accompanied by automatic tags reflecting the modded elements.
[*]Race loading: Significant optimisation of loading times.
[*]Added : A new "safemode" mode is available to help our support. [list][*]To activate it, go in Steam library > Pro Cycling Manager 2016 > Property > "Set Launch Options" > add the line "-safemode"[/list][/list]

If you encounter any issues to use your customized data base in mutliplayer, you can launch PCM16 in "safe mode" (see above to use the "safe mode").

We're actively working to fix this issue as soon as possible.

[b]Cyanide Studio & Focus Home Interactive[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're pleased to announce that a second update for Pro Cycling Manager 2016 is imminent!

You might be disconnected once during the server reset, it means we started the patch deployment.

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version!

Here is the patch log:

[h1][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Optimisation of calculation of ladder rankings.
[*]Optimisation of calculation of list of playable tournaments.
[*]Fixed: Some players appeared in the wrong tournament after asking to join.
[*]Added a countdown to the list of tournaments to indicate when the list will refresh.
[*]Fixed: the age column of riders in multiplayer was removed (displayed
0 for clients)
[*]Fixed: some stages in ladder mode could not be loaded.
[*]Ladder rankings will again appear in multiplayer
[*]The time for selection of riders in ladder stage mode passes from 10 seconds to 45 seconds.[/list]

[h1][b]Career and Pro Cyclist[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed: bad fitness schedules for riders in the second season (including riders with no schedule)

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're pleased to announce that a second update for Pro Cycling Manager 2016 is imminent!

You might be disconnected once during the server reset, it means we started the patch deployment.

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version!

Here is the patch log:

[h1][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Optimisation of calculation of ladder rankings.
[*]Optimisation of calculation of list of playable tournaments.
[*]Fixed: Some players appeared in the wrong tournament after asking to join.
[*]Added a countdown to the list of tournaments to indicate when the list will refresh.
[*]Fixed: the age column of riders in multiplayer was removed (displayed
0 for clients)
[*]Fixed: some stages in ladder mode could not be loaded.
[*]Ladder rankings will again appear in multiplayer
[*]The time for selection of riders in ladder stage mode passes from 10 seconds to 45 seconds.[/list]
